Matt Estes 

Matt Estes began his career at BCR in 2020 as a sales representative, quickly demonstrating his drive and ability to excel. Through his dedication and impressive performance, Matt advanced through the ranks, becoming a sales manager and then a general manager. In his current role as Assistant Vice President of Sales, Matt’s focus is on growing the sales force and ensuring that they are more efficient and effective in their efforts. His leadership has played a key role in enhancing the team’s performance and driving the company’s growth.

Matt is deeply committed to not only increasing sales but also improving the overall sales process, ensuring that his team has the tools and support they need to succeed. His passion for leadership and development helps cultivate a high-performing sales environment.

Outside of work, Matt enjoys spending time with his wife, whether it’s on the golf course or bowling, always finding balance between work and play.
